posts.text: Our outbound numbers in Q1 were embarrassing. 0.4% reply rate. Spent the last six weeks rebuilding our process around prospect research — every email has to reference something the recipient said publicly in the last 30 days. Reply rate is now 6.8%. Personalization is not a feature, it's the whole thing.

Closed our second enterprise contract this month. Both deals came from outbound — both required four months of nurture. Anyone telling you outbound is dead is selling something. It works. It just takes patience and craft.
